priority_source.focus: High: custom fluids/contact and world progression/acquisition. This partition contains 23 fluid PRs; world-generation acquisition is not claimed completed by this group.

implementation.scope: Additive bounded nearest-drop routing, same registry/revision, existing native scheduled tick delegate. Definition/default behavior preserved.
implementation.tc_candidate: Excluded PR716 four-metal flow-routing mapping at final d82 IDs. NOT full fluid registration or activation.
remaining: Actual Rust API tests, new complete plan/guards/host type have not run.
Existing contact callback lacks mutable Game/actor continuation; item-use cloud capability is not contact authority.
Native per-effect curative data/copy/save remains unresolved; no new side table.
Burn/travel/current/drowning/fall, upward flow, fog/overlay, native path choice, source conversion/mixing/waterlogging, save/LAN parity remain separate.

architecture.shared: Single Pluto registry, immutable definitions/render/slope facts, bounded common kernel, native world writes/Spread::Fluid protection and scheduled tick remain internal.
architecture.consumer: TC identities/assets/acquisition, per-family numeric policies, burn/effects/immunities/visuals remain TC-owned.
architecture.native_item: Current cloud candidate uses actual Game native-item invocation plus Ready/epoch/reserve/push; actual plan/guard proof exists, Game9/live operations still unrun.
architecture.protection: Native damage/protection facade covers already-authorized health calls; it cannot grant contact timing or movement/actor lifetime.
